issues.description: The solution implementation of Client.assembleBookstore has an incorrect return type: it is declared to return [Book] but actually returns a Bookstore instance. This contradicts the problem statement (which requires assembleBookstore to create and return a Bookstore) and the template (the commented stub returns Bookstore). As written the solution would not compile and confuses students about the intended return type of assembleBookstore and how Client.main should use its result.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the assembleBookstore method signature consistent with the problem statement and template. Change its return type to Bookstore (e.g. private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore) so that it returns and the caller receives a Bookstore instance. Alternatively, if the intended design were to return [Book], update Client.main and the problem statement/template accordingly, but the simplest fix is to update the solution signature to -> Bookstore and ensure the returned value remains Bookstore(books: books).
